purpose: Physical AX3000T exact-C versus current R124 broad ubusd matrix; descriptive latency/CPU evidence only.
schedule: C,R124,R124,C repeated four times; 16 fresh guarded windows; no extensions
primary_metric: per-operation latency_ns mean/percentiles from strict validated benchmark JSON
strict_validation: lookup-fixture checks exact ordered paths, count, unique stable nonzero IDs and complete ping signature; rpc-fixture checks exact OBJID+DATA bytes and no FD. Four-client legacy rpc lane remains supplemental and is fully JSON validated by existing client.
limitations: This matrix does not measure p99 across an application population; it reports benchmark per-operation samples and existing process CPU intervals.
Pathless lookup uses strict full returned object bytes parsed by the frozen client; raw wire framing is not captured.
The four-client daemon interval is shared and overlapping; per-client daemon counters are not summed.
No overall 90:10 score is invented without workload weights.
